data_window: 2026-08-11 00:00 to 2026-08-14 10:46 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_14_*.json and selected repository metadata/README audits under /tmp/radar_2026_08_14_repo_audit/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main. Discovery used GitHub Search API queries for repositories created since 2026-08-11 matching AI agent, MCP, LLM app and browser agent terms. Selected repository metadata and README heads were collected locally. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, device-permission-tested, credential-tested or security-scanned.
trend_observations: The strongest fresh product signal is agent execution moving onto real, persistent surfaces: paired iPhone control, visible browser sessions and desktop computer use. Multi-agent engineering is becoming a governed coordination product through worktree isolation, write leases, verification evidence and merge queues. MCP differentiation is shifting toward action control, device execution and auditable real-browser state. RAG candidates are more compelling when ingestion, retrieval, a usable visualization or desktop UI, and callable access are one closed-loop product.
assumptions: Stars, forks and timestamps are point-in-time GitHub API metadata, not exact growth deltas. Scores emphasize product surface, clear audience, recent creation or updates, README/source runnability clues and AI-native architecture. README evidence is directional. No install, Docker, npm, Cargo, Swift/Xcode, browser, mobile device, model provider, OAuth, security or production deployment audit was performed.
